articles.title: Blasts reported in Iran as US launches new wave of strikes
articles.description: Iran says US strikes hit bridges in the country in an apparent escalation, while the US boards a ship in the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: JD Vance accuses Israel of 'manipulating' US public opinion to prolong Iran war
articles.description: The US vice president says he thinks some Israeli politicians are trying to detail efforts to end the conflict.

articles.title: US military to start screening for testosterone deficiency, Hegseth says
articles.description: Hegseth says he is authorising hormone screening to ensure US troops "operate at your absolute best".
